memories.content: The doctor I still remember from childhood used to draw these messy little body maps on scrap paper. I hated the glossy handouts because they made me feel like nobody was really thinking with me.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers rough improvised visual explanation over polished official materials.

memories.content: I have a rule where big purchases sit in my notes app for two days before I touch them. Otherwise I start pretending future-attending money is already real.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya delays large purchases because she is cautious about early-career debt.

memories.content: I get excited when a menu has tamarind, curry leaves, chaat masala, or that railway-snack kind of flavor. I’ll pick that over a proper restaurant half the time.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers tangy Indian street-snack flavors over conventionally polished dining.

memories.content: I know it sounds dumb, but I’ll pick a boring pond with ducks over the famous scenic route. I like the stupid little waterfowl.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers mundane pond/waterfowl routes over famous scenic routes.

memories.content: I learn better from ugly little case fragments than from clean board-review summaries. The polished stuff makes me skim.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya retains rough, unfinished case fragments better than polished summaries.

memories.content: I keep paying for that route app because it finds quiet little loops I would never notice on my own.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya values a route-planning app for finding quiet running loops.

memories.content: I’d rather repeat the same two outfits than lose my weekly dosa budget. Clothes are background noise to me unless something is actually falling apart.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya deprioritizes clothing variety and prioritizes a specific weekly dosa habit.

memories.content: I don’t care if the restaurant block is famous. I like when dinner is next to one of those boring commuter paths where people jog after work.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers restaurants near ordinary commuter jogging paths over famous dining districts.

memories.content: I don’t trust myself with flexible budgets right now. Give me the annoying version with envelopes and limits, or I’ll rationalize everything.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya wants restrictive envelope-style budgeting rather than flexible budgeting.

memories.content: Before pickleball, the thing that works is embarrassing: cold, tangy, snacky, barely a meal. Proper food makes me sluggish.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers cold/tangy/snacky food before pickleball, even though it seems less meal-like.

memories.content: If I pay extra for travel, I want it to change the actual experience, not just make the receipt look fancier.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers experiential travel upgrades over comfort/status upgrades.

memories.content: My reliable lunch is basically chaos in a bowl: yogurt, pickle, crunch, heat. If it looks too normal, I get bored by day two.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers chaotic tangy/crunchy/spicy lunch bowls over standard healthy lunches.

memories.inferred_memory: Priya's graduation trip is the second week of July.

memories.content: The graduation trip is the last week of June.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya's graduation trip is the last week of June.

memories.inferred_memory: Priya plays pickleball on Tuesday evenings.

memories.content: Pickleball is Thursdays at seven.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya plays pickleball on Thursday evenings.

memories.inferred_memory: Priya's monthly student loan payment is $450.

memories.content: My monthly loan payment is three-twenty.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya's monthly student loan payment is $320.

memories.inferred_memory: Priya's NP certification exam is October 3rd.

memories.content: The certification exam is September fifteenth.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya's NP certification exam is September 15th.

memories.content: I run with Meera Sunday mornings at eight.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya runs with Meera on Sunday mornings.

memories.content: I run with Meera Saturday mornings at seven.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya runs with Meera on Saturday mornings.

memories.content: My dosa spot is Sai Tiffins on Devon.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya's regular dosa place is Sai Tiffins on Devon Avenue.

memories.content: My dosa spot is Dosa Express on Clark.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya's regular dosa place is Dosa Express on Clark Street.

memories.content: The weekly dosa place is the food thing I would rather keep. It is not fancy, but I look forward to it.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya wants to preserve a weekly dosa restaurant habit.

memories.content: Food spending is the category where the loan spreadsheet starts looking annoying fastest, but I still value the weekly dosa place as its the one time I get to relax..
memories.inferred_memory: Priya finds food related spending challenging, but would rather preserve it as it allows her to de-stress.

memories.content: Repeating the same little running loop works better for me than constantly changing routes.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers repeating a familiar running loop.

memories.content: My knee gets irritated when I stack too many similar running days together.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya needs to avoid too many repeated running days because of knee irritation.

memories.content: I like outdoor trips, but I get more excited by plain little ponds and birdy paths than by big adventure itineraries.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers low-key outdoor water-adjacent travel over organized adventure travel.

memories.content: I want weekend trips to stop turning into surprise budget problems.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya wants low-cost weekend travel.

memories.content: Before pickleball, I still want the tamarind-y crunchy thing. Plain protein food feels like homework.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya wants tangy crunchy food before pickleball.

memories.content: If I eat a full meal before pickleball, I feel slow for the first few games.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya needs light food before pickleball.

memories.content: If a study plan feels too gentle, I start treating it like a suggestion instead of a plan.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya wants a demanding study structure.

memories.content: When I let studying eat sleep, my judgment gets worse and I pretend it is discipline.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya needs to protect sleep while studying.

memories.content: I want the loans to get hit early, even if it reduces flexibility a little.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya wants aggressive student loan repayment.

memories.content: If I over-restrict food spending, I end up buying random snacks after shifts.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya rebounds into random spending when food spending is over-restricted.

memories.content: A plain little water path can make a weekend work for me better than a packed landmark itinerary.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers low-key water-adjacent walking over prestige sightseeing.

memories.content: I do not need the restaurant to be famous. I want the snack-counter version: tamarind, crunch, yogurt, heat.
memories.inferred_memory: Priya prefers unfussy tangy snack-counter food over famous restaurants.
